title: Associate - Project Manager
description:
Job Description: EXL is seeking a hands\-on analytics implementation engineer to execute audit and QA work across web and app properties for a multi\-brand digital client. The role is responsible for running event validation, querying BigQuery for data quality issues, validating mobile tracking payloads, and maintaining tracking documentation throughout the engagement. This is an execution and delivery role for someone who is rigorous about accuracy, thorough in documentation, and comfortable working across GA4, GTM, AppsFlyer, and BigQuery.


  
Responsibilities: • Execute web audit checklist items: walk through each customer journey using GTM Preview and the browser DevTools network tab — product view, add to cart, checkout, purchase, sign\-in, and form submission. For each step, confirm the correct event fires with the right parameters.
  

• Validate GA4 events in DebugView: confirm event name, required parameters, correct data types, and absence of PII in parameter values.
  

• Run BigQuery data quality queries: surface (not set) volumes in source and medium, purchase events with missing values, duplicate events, and parameters that do not match the tracking spec.
  

• Support AppsFlyer event validation: cross\-reference AppsFlyer event logs against the tracking spec and document any discrepancies with evidence.
  

• Log all findings in the audit tracker: surface, category, root cause, evidence, and recommended fix. The tracker is the primary input to the gap report.
  

• Maintain tracking documentation: draft event tables, parameter definitions, and implementation code snippet templates from specifications provided by the engagement lead.
  

• Prepare status reporting: pull current metrics and format findings for governance meeting summaries, flagging any new anomalies since the previous update.
  

Required skills \& experience
  

• Google Analytics 4 — navigate reports, use DebugView in real time, build Exploration reports, and understand the purchase event structure.
  

• Google Tag Manager — use GTM Preview mode, read tag and trigger configurations, and identify firing issues.
  

• Browser DevTools (network tab) — filter for the GA4 collect endpoint, inspect request payloads, and identify missing or malformed parameters.
  

• BigQuery and SQL — write queries against GA4 event export tables to identify data quality issues and summarise results for reporting.
  

• Structured documentation — produce clear, consistent audit checklists, findings logs, event tables, and data dictionaries.


  
Qualifications: AppsFlyer — navigate the dashboard, read event logs, and cross\-reference attribution data against GA4\.
  

• Firebase DebugView — enable debug mode and validate in\-app events in real time.
  

• Experience producing audit deliverables or gap reports in a consulting or agency context.
  

• Familiarity with Android emulator or device\-based tag validation for app audit work.
  

Education \& experience
  

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  

• 2–5 years in digital analytics implementation or QA, with hands\-on use of GA4, GTM, and BigQuery.
  

• Experience in a consulting or agency delivery environment is preferred.

title: Assistant Project Manager
description:
**Position:** Assistant Project Manager (APM)  
**Department:** Projects / Construction  
**Location:** Gurugram  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reporting To:** Project Manager

Job Summary

We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented Assistant Project Manager to support the Project Manager in planning, coordinating, and executing residential and commercial construction projects. The candidate will assist in managing site activities, project schedules, budgets, contractor coordination, quality control, and project documentation to ensure timely and successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist the Project Manager in planning, execution, and monitoring of construction projects.
* Coordinate with site engineers, contractors, consultants, architects, and vendors to ensure smooth project execution.
* Track project progress, timelines, and milestones, and prepare periodic progress reports.
* Monitor project costs, material consumption, and resource utilization to ensure adherence to budget.
* Review drawings, BOQs, specifications, and project documents for execution support.
* Conduct regular site visits to monitor work quality, safety compliance, and construction progress.
* Coordinate procurement of materials and ensure timely availability at project sites.
* Support preparation of project schedules, work plans, and manpower deployment plans.
* Assist in managing subcontractors, billing, work orders, and vendor documentation.
* Identify project risks, delays, and site issues and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with quality standards, safety regulations, and company policies.
* Maintain project records, reports, approvals, and documentation for project audits and handover.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* 2–7 years of experience in construction project execution, preferably in residential and commercial projects.
* Knowledge of construction methodologies, project scheduling, and site management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Project, AutoCAD, and project management tools.
* Strong communication, coordination, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under deadlines.

Preferred Skills

* Understanding of BOQ preparation, rate analysis, and project budgeting.
* Knowledge of quality control procedures and construction safety standards.
* Experience in contractor and vendor management.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Leadership and team coordination abilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of project milestones.
* Adherence to project budget and cost control.
* Quality compliance and reduced rework.
* Site safety compliance.
* Effective contractor and stakeholder coordination.
* Accuracy and timeliness of project reporting.

Pay: ₹239,561\.12 \- ₹1,601,518\.97 per year

Work Location: In person

### **Job Description**

Job Title: **Project Manager \- Rail Metro Projects**

Job Location: **Dhaka, Bangladesh**

**Join Us!**

We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy’s deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!


This role requires handling Project execution of DC 3rd Rail/ AC Overhead Traction/DC Overhead Catenary Rail Metro Projects and ensure that all related activities are performed in accordance with Linxon policy, contractual agreements, quality standards, health, safety \& environment requirements, financial targets, as well as schedule commitments.


**What will you do?**

**1\. Project leadership:** Leads the project team allocated to the project, defining main guidelines, allocating project tasks, and motivating and monitoring internal and external resources to accomplish all tasks and milestones. Provides performance feedback regarding allocated resources working on projects.


**2\. Planning and scheduling:** Defines, jointly with the Project Controls department, all project plan documents, including scope and financial plans, schedule and risk management plans.


**3\. Project execution and control:** Ensures that the project follows execution best practices and ABB policies. Effectively monitors and controls project progress and efficient resource utilization. Monitors and controls project financials, overseeing project invoicing status, cost, expenses and cash flow. Identifies, qualifies, quantifies and manages project risks, and ensures that all opportunities are identified and pursued. Captures, analyzes and shares lessons learned throughout the project.\\


**4\. Project closure:** Ensures that the project is formally closed out, as contractually agreed. Drives the formal acceptance of the project, contract close\-out and its acknowledgement by the customer.


**5\. Contract and claims:** Ensures that the project consistently applies contract and claims management, in accordance with Linxon policies and contractual agreements.


**6\. Procurement:** Coordinates with Supply Chain Management, and successfully procures required services, materials and equipment for the project from external and internal suppliers. Support Supply Chain Management in supplier negotiations, claims and project changes.


**7\. Stakeholder relations:** Acts as key contact for the customer and an escalation point for project issues. Builds and maintains strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders and effectively communicates with all stakeholders.


**8\. Sustainability:** Ensures the project follows and complies with company health \& safety, environmental and security policies.


**Experience, Education and other Required:**
=============================================

* BE/B.Tech Degree in Electrical Engineering or Equivalent discipline.
* Overall 25 years in Project Management and minimum 10 years of experience in OHE Rail Projects
* **Leadership Competency:** Strategic Orientation, Change Management, People Management, Intercultural Sensitivity.
* **Multitasking Skill:** Able to monitor the progress of large size project with knowledge of Civil interface, Signaling, Rolling Stock, Scada etc.
* **Claim Management** \- Must be thorough with claim management, Change orders and Project financials.
* **Health and Safety** \- Must have good knowledge of Health and Safety ensuring Safe site activities.

**ED\&I:**

When it comes to diversity and inclusion, we see things differently at Linxon \- we encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations and more \- so whoever you are, we hope you’ll see things our way, too.


**About Linxon**

Building the infrastructure to power the world with carbon\-free energy.


We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy’s leading technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon.


Linxon’s vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world\-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects.


As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a new company as it evolves and help shape it for the future. If you like new challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are interested in working with other motivated professionals with expertise in the Substations EPC business, then this is the new opportunity for you.


To know more about Linxon : www.linxon.com or watch our video:


Building the infrastructure to power the world \- we are Linxon! \- YouTube

Employee

Regular
